answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by requiring each identity to post a refundable stake that is slashed when misbehavior is proven: creating a thousand hollow sock-puppets becomes expensive instead of free, because every fake must lock real value upfront. Reputation then accrues only through a verifiable voyage of completed work - successful deliveries, on-time attestations, and dispute-free trades - so a newcomer cannot simply spawn a lagoon of fresh accounts and outvote honest incumbents overnight.
